key_findings: In 120 chronic migraine patients, acupuncture gave a higher effective rate (93.0%) than flunarizine (79.3%) and lowered serum VEGF and CGRP while raising 5-HT.
Mechanism is proposed to involve regulation of serum 5-HT, CGRP and VEGF.
